passive.name: Dauntless Instinct
passive.description:
K'Sante's Abilities mark targets to take more damage on his next Attack.

When All Out, K'Sante deals more damage with all Attacks and Abilities.

spells.name: Ntofo Strikes
spells.description:
K'Sante strikes, damaging and slowing enemies in a short line.

On hit, grants a stack of Ntofo Strikes. At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in.

When All Out, cooldown is reduced.
spells.tooltip:
K'Sante slams his weapon, dealing {{ basedamage }} physical damage and Slowing enemies by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }}s. If he hits, he gains a stack of Ntofo Strikes for {{ recastwindow }} seconds. At 2 stacks, he instead fires a shockwave that Stuns and Pulls enemies for {{ stunduration }} second.

All Out: Cooldown is reduced by {{ rcooldownreduction.0*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Path Maker
spells.description:
K'Sante charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning enemies.

When All Out, deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns.
spells.tooltip:
K'Sante raises his weapons defensively for {{ mindurationtooltip }}-{{ maxduration.1 }}s, becoming Unstoppable and reducing incoming damage by {{ damagereduction*100 }}%. Then, he rams forward, dealing {{ basedamage }} + {{ totalmaxhealthdamage }} max Health physical damage. Enemies hit are Knocked Back and Stunned for {{ minknockbackduration }}-{{ maxknockbackduration }}s (based on charge time).

All Out: Cooldown is refreshed. Deals an additional {{ rdamageincreasemin*100 }}-{{ rdamageincreasemax*100 }}% damage as true damage (based on charge time), damage reduction is increased to {{ rdamagereduction*100 }}% and dash speed is increased, but no longer Knocks Back or Stuns.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Footwork
spells.description:
K'Sante dashes and gains a shield. If targeting an ally, K'Sante dashes to the ally with increased range and both gain a shield.

When All Out, cooldown is reduced and speed is increased.
spells.tooltip:
K'Sante dashes, gaining {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. If dashing to an ally, the distance of the dash is significantly increased and the ally is also Shielded.

All Out: Cooldown is decreased by {{ cooldownmodao*100 }}% and dash speed is increased.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: All Out
spells.description: K'Sante knocks an enemy back, launching them through any wall in their path. Then, K'Sante goes All Out and dashes after them, gaining increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses.
spells.tooltip:
K'Sante shatters his ntofos to Knock Back an enemy champion, dealing {{ basedamage }} physical damage, then dashes behind them and goes All Out for {{ alloutduration }}s. If the enemy would hit a wall, they are Knocked Back through the wall and K'Sante strikes them again for {{ totaldamageslamdown }} physical damage.

While All Out, K'Sante's Abilities are upgraded and he gains {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed, {{ armorpenpercent*100 }}% Bonus Armor Penetration, and {{ omnivamp*100 }}% Omnivamp, but loses {{ healthlost*100 }}% max Health, {{ defenseslost*100 }}% Bonus Armor, and {{ defenseslost*100 }}% Bonus Magic Resistance.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Dauntless Instinct
effects: Innate: K'Sante's abilities mark enemies hit for 4 seconds. His basic attacks against marked enemies are empowered to consume the mark on-hit, dealing 12 (+ 1% : 2% (based on level) of target's maximum health) bonus physical damage. The damage based on the target's health has a minimum of 15 : 100 (based on level) against minions and is capped at 20 : 105 (based on level) against monsters.

All Out Bonus: K'Sante's basic attacks and ability damage, as well as Dauntless Instinct's mark consumption, are empowered to deal bonus physical damage equal to 1% (+ 1% per 100 bonus armor) (+ 1% per 100 bonus magic resistance) of the target's maximum health.

variants.name: Ntofo Strikes
effects: If this hits at least one enemy, K'Sante generates a stack for 6 seconds, stacking up to 2 times and refreshing on subsequent hits. At 2 stacks, the next Ntofo Strikes cast consumes them all to become empowered with a new effect.
Empowered Active: K'Sante fires a shockwave in the target direction that applies the same effects to enemies hit, but also pulls them towards him over 0.65 seconds and stuns them for 0.8 seconds.

All Out Bonus: Ntofo Strikes' cooldown is reduced by 33%, with a minimum total cooldown of 1.33 seconds. Upon entering All Out, Ntofo Strikes' stacks are reset. Ntofo Strikes' cooldown is reset if K'Sante had 2 stacks before entering All Out.
Ntofo Strikes resets K'Sante's basic attack timer.

effects: Active: K'Sante raises his ntofos defensively and prepares to dash in the target direction, charging for a minimum of 0.4 seconds and up to 1 second. During this time, he gains displacement immunity and 30% damage reduction; additionally, Path Maker's range, stun duration, and All Out bonus true damage modifier increase over the first 0.9 seconds of the channel.
Path Maker can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. Path Maker's charge cannot be interrupted by crowd control.
Ntofo Strikes and All Out can be cast during the dash. Path Maker's recast can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

variants.name: Footwork
effects: Footwork can also be cast on allies with increased range and speed, and the ability to dash through terrain. If the target ally is a champion, they receive the shield as well.
All Out Bonus: Footwork's dash speed is increased, and its cooldown is reduced by 50%.
K'Sante can cast any of his abilities during the dash.

variants.name: All Out
effects: After K'Sante blinks, he enters All Out for 15 seconds.

K'Sante retains his maximum health and bonus resistances during All Out. Health lost from gaining the health threshold is not restored after the effect ends. If the target is pulled over terrain that is longer than 2000 units, K'Sante will vanish during their displacement and reappear near the end of it.
